hypothesis: Cross-sectional risk-adjusted medium-term momentum persists among liquid equities: the 12-month return skipping the most recent month, divided by 60-day realized volatility, identifies persistent relative winners and losers. A dollar-neutral long-short portfolio of the top and bottom 25 names, rebalanced weekly on Fridays using only information available at the close, harvests this premium while capping each position at 2% and gross exposure at 100%. Eligibility and liquidity filters avoid non-tradable or illiquid names, and weekly holding reduces turnover relative to daily rebalancing.
